cards.power: The Density-Mapper. Ray shoots through the body; bones stop him (White), air lets him fly (black); everything else is grey.
cards.lore: Calcium or Bone is a Heavy Hitter that blocks the beam, creating the shadow-silhouette.
cards.gradeReason: Instant embodiment — you ARE the X-ray beam blasting through flesh.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro wrestler card. Subject: Charging bull skeleton glowing white on X-ray film. Mood: Primal, illuminating.

cards.power: The Slice-and-Dice. Hunter spins, creating 3D volumes that can be sliced in any direction.
cards.lore: X-Ray Attenuation calculates precise density. Distinguishes Fresh-Blood (+80 HU) from Simple-Fluid (0 HU).
cards.gradeReason: Spinning hunter persona is immediately performable. HU as battle stats — genius.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro monster card. Subject: Rhinoceros centaur spinning CT gantry, slicing anatomy into luminous cross-sections. Mood: Relentless, precise.

cards.power: The Bounce-Back. Fluid is Black (Silent), Bone is White-Noisy (Hyperechoic).
cards.lore: Based on Acoustic Impedance. Watches the Heart Pump in real-time without hurting it.
cards.gradeReason: Echolocating bat bouncing sound — zero friction, anyone can play this.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro nature card. Subject: Cartoon bat sending sound-wave rings through pulsing heart, fluid black and bone white. Mood: Gentle, real-time.

cards.power: The Proton-Spinner. Mag makes the body's Water-Protons dance to his magnetic rhythm.
cards.lore: Unlocks Soft-Tissue Secrets. Sees the nerves and ligaments that Roentgen-Ray completely misses.
cards.gradeReason: Magnetic fox making protons dance — pure performative gold. Best card in deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro elemental card. Subject: Electric fox surrounded by spinning water-proton aurora, rainbow soft-tissue secrets emerging. Mood: Mysterious, powerful.

cards.power: The Boundary-Blur. Tells you exactly which Lobe-Lobby is full of fluid.
cards.lore: You only see a border when Air meets Water. If Water meets Water, the line is erased.
cards.gradeReason: Clear concept but needs table context to perform the 'disappearing border' move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro ghost card. Subject: Bear silhouette dissolving where fluid meets fluid, lung lobe border erasing. Mood: Eerie, diagnostic.

cards.power: The Fluid-Ladder. When the Heart-Pump fails, Lymphatic-Drains overflow, drawing rungs on the ladder.
cards.lore: Thickened interlobular septa. The first sign the lungs are becoming a Swamp.
cards.gradeReason: Frog on a ladder of overflowing lymphatics — immediate and visual.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro swamp card. Subject: Frog climbing flooded lung ladder, horizontal rungs drawn by drowning lymphatics. Mood: Ominous, early-warning.

cards.power: The Dead-Zone. The PE-Phantom blocks an artery; a wedge of tissue dies and turns white.
cards.lore: Ischemic necrosis of parenchyma. Revealed by a Filling Defect in the pipe on CT-Angio.
cards.gradeReason: Dead-Zone is vivid but Hampton's Hump wedge needs PE context to click.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro horror card. Subject: Wolf phantom blocking lung artery, wedge of dead white tissue spreading below. Mood: Fatal, silent.

cards.power: The Tubule-Glow. Shows the Air-Pipes running through a solid Infection-Block.
cards.lore: Proof that Alveolar-Balloons are full of pus, but Airway-Tunnels remain open.
cards.gradeReason: Glowing airways in pus-block is clear once you see it, but needs X-ray context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro infection card. Subject: Badger charging through solid white lung block, air bronchi glowing as tunnels of light. Mood: Stubborn, illuminating.

cards.power: The Leak-Detector. Appears when a pipe pops, letting air escape into the belly.
cards.lore: Normally you only see the inside. If you see the outside too, there is Free-Air-Frenzy.
cards.gradeReason: Double wall = double trouble. Anyone sees the outside, they know the pipe popped.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro plumbing card. Subject: Infinity-loop serpent bowel both walls outlined, free air escaping into darkened belly cavity. Mood: Urgent, surgical.

cards.power: The Twist-Indicator. Shows exactly where the colon has a Twisted-Spaghetti Obstruction.
cards.lore: A closed-loop surgical emergency. If not untwisted, it becomes Necrosis-Nick.
cards.gradeReason: Walrus coffee-bean colon is absurd and perfect. Emergency stakes are crystal clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro grotesque card. Subject: Bloated walrus-seal colon twisted coffee-bean shape, surgical emergency red alarm flashing. Mood: Tragicomic, urgent.

cards.power: The Crime-Scene-Pointer. Stays perfectly still and bloated, pointing at the Inflammation-Riot.
cards.lore: Localized paralysis of the gut caused by nearby Cytokine-Chaos.
cards.gradeReason: Bloated sloth sentinel refusing to move — instantly playable, unforgettable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro detective card. Subject: Sloth sentinel standing motionless, single bloated bowel loop pointing accusingly toward hidden inflammation. Mood: Still, ominous.

cards.power: The Stricture-Signal. Shows where chronic inflammation turns the Gut-Highway into a Narrow-Thread.
cards.lore: Transmural scarring and spasm. If the thread completely breaks, a Fistula forms.
cards.gradeReason: Thread highway is clear but Crohn's-specific context needed for full performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro disease card. Subject: Worm narrowing into single thread, gut highway barely passable, fistula crack forming. Mood: Chronic, relentless.

cards.power: The Brain-Bully. Occurs when a Brain-Bleed pushes the whole brain-center to one side.
cards.lore: The skull is a Fixed-Box. If Mitch pushes too hard, he causes Herniation-Harry — the total system crash.
cards.gradeReason: Brain-bully gorilla is vivid but the fixed-box skull mechanic needs explaining first.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro neuro card. Subject: Gorilla fist pushing brain center sideways, septum pellucidum shifting toward herniation. Mood: Relentless, catastrophic.

cards.power: The Slow-Squeeze. A Venous-Leak that slowly wraps around the brain like a creeping shadow.
cards.lore: Tearing of Bridging-Veins. Common in Elderly-Wrestling after a minor Tumble.
cards.gradeReason: Crescent shadow creeping — slow, sinister, you feel the slow squeeze immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro shadow card. Subject: Sloth blood crescent wrapping elderly brain, concave shadow crossing sutures. Mood: Slow, insidious.

cards.power: The High-Pressure-Punch. An Arterial-Burst building fast, punching a sharp lens-shape.
cards.lore: Tearing of Middle Meningeal-Artery. Features a Lucid-Interval before total blackout.
cards.gradeReason: Ram punching a lens-shaped hematoma fast — you ARE the arterial burst.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro impact card. Subject: Ram headbutt creating convex lemon lens hematoma, arterial blood building at speed. Mood: Fast, explosive.

cards.power: The Edema-Finder. Turns off the White-Noise of normal CSF so only Inflammation-Fluid glows.
cards.lore: Essential for spotting MS-the-Plaque-Maker or Stroke-Steve.
cards.gradeReason: Silencing CSF noise to reveal MS plaques — needs MRI literacy to embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro dark-scanner card. Subject: Black wolf in MRI cave, CSF noise cancelled, only inflammation glowing bright white. Mood: Revealing, silent.

cards.power: The Barrier-Breaker. Only shows up where the Blood-Brain-Barrier is broken by Tumor-Max.
cards.lore: Garry makes things Bright-White on T1. If it glows, it's growing or it's angry.
cards.gradeReason: Glows where barriers break — if it lights up, it's bad news. Immediate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro contrast card. Subject: Silver fox piercing blood-brain barrier, tumor glowing white-hot on T1. Mood: Electric, revelatory.

cards.power: The Vessel-Painter. Iodine turns blood into White-Flowing-Lava on a CT scan.
cards.lore: Finds Hank-the-Hemorrhage or Clot-the-Blocker. Caveat: Watch out for the kidneys!
cards.gradeReason: Painting blood into lava-white rivers — beautiful, immediately playable persona.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro contrast card. Subject: Octopus painting CT vessel tree white-lava, kidneys glowing warning-red in corner. Mood: Vivid, urgent.

cards.power: The Gut-Coater. Barium paints the Digestive-Tunnel lining, revealing Percy-the-Ulcer.
cards.lore: High density allows for Double-Contrast (Air + Barium) to see incredibly fine surface detail.
cards.gradeReason: Chalk-coating the gut is clear but double-contrast technique needs demonstration.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro chalk-coat card. Subject: Hippo painting gut walls chalky-white, ulcer revealed by double-contrast air-barium study. Mood: Thorough, revealing.

cards.power: The Kidney-Stunner. Nephro strikes when Iodine-the-Ion is too harsh on the Renal-Tubes.
cards.lore: Prevented by Fluid-Flooding before the scan. High-risk for Diabetes-Dan.
cards.gradeReason: Kidney stunner is vivid but the prevention mechanic adds needed clinical context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro complication card. Subject: Cartoon kidneys recoiling from iodine overload, creatinine spike graph red warning 24-48h. Mood: Reactive, cautionary.

cards.power: The Spine-Snap. Shows a stress-fracture in the Pars-Interarticularis.
cards.lore: Common in Gymnast-and-Wrestler athletes who ask their backs too much.
cards.gradeReason: Broken-neck Scottie dog is a great mnemonic but only clicks once you've seen the sign.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro skeleton card. Subject: Scottie dog spine oblique view, pars interarticularis 'neck' cracked, athlete backstory visible. Mood: Fragile, overloaded.

cards.power: The Hidden-Blood-Detector. Shows the Shadow-of-Blood even if the fracture is invisible.
cards.lore: Blood filling the joint capsule physically pushes the normal fat pads out of their hiding spots.
cards.gradeReason: Fat pads pushed by blood is clever but needs X-ray orientation to perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro hidden-clue card. Subject: Kangaroo elbow sail sign fat pad displaced by blood, invisible fracture lurking beneath. Mood: Subtle, revealing.

cards.power: The Staircase-Sign. Shows exactly where a joint has Slipped-the-Gears.
cards.lore: A stark indicator of Ligament-Laceration or unstable, sliding fractures.
cards.gradeReason: Staircase step-off — you feel the joint slipping gears immediately. No setup needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro fracture card. Subject: Mountain goats locking horns, joint surfaces misaligned in visible staircase step, ligaments torn. Mood: Sharp, unstable.

cards.power: The Bone-Explosion. Malignant-Max Tumor grows so fast it blasts through the bone-armor.
cards.lore: The bone tries to build new periosteum armor but fails, leaving radiating Sunray-Spikes.
cards.gradeReason: Bone exploding into sunburst spikes — grotesque, vivid, zero ambiguity.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro malignant card. Subject: Porcupine bone tumor erupting sunray periosteal spikes, failed armor shredding outward. Mood: Explosive, malignant.

cards.power: The Gallstone-Guard. Cathy-the-Gallstone is so hard that zero sound waves can pass through.
cards.lore: Sound is reflected 100% by the surface, leaving the area behind it absolutely Silent-and-Black.
cards.gradeReason: Zero sound through stone — perfect physical logic, plays itself at any table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro acoustic card. Subject: Turtle gallstone casting total dark shadow, zero sound penetrating, black void below. Mood: Absolute, impenetrable.

cards.power: The Metal-Finder. Appears when sound hits a rigid Needle or a Stent.
cards.lore: Sound bounces back and forth infinitely inside the metal, confusing the machine into seeing a long Tail.
cards.gradeReason: Reverberation artifact needs ultrasound physics context before it clicks for players.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro artifact card. Subject: Swordfish trailing comet-tail echoes from metal stent, infinite reverb confusion. Mood: Chaotic, metallic.

cards.power: The Flow-Meter. Shows if blood is blasting Toward (Red) or away (Blue) from the Pipe-Highway or stalled by a clot.
cards.lore: Remember BART: Blue Away, Red Toward. Essential for tracking down Doris-the-DVT.
cards.gradeReason: BART mnemonic baked into the card. Red toward, blue away — instant recall.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro flow card. Subject: Colorful fish streaming red toward and blue away in vessel highway, Doris-DVT lurking. Mood: Dynamic, color-coded.

cards.power: The Stagnant-Pool. Sludge is the Pre-Stone-Thickening of bile that slowly shifts with gravity.
cards.lore: Micro-crystals and heavy mucus settling quietly at the absolute bottom of the Biliary-Bucket.
cards.gradeReason: Quietly settling sludge is accurate but lacks the urgency that makes a card pop.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sediment card. Subject: Toad at bottom of gallbladder, bile sludge gravity-settling, micro-crystals forming pre-stone layer. Mood: Slow, accumulating.

cards.power: The Repair-Radar. Glows bright wherever Bone-Builders are working overtime to fix damage.
cards.lore: Excellent for sniffing out Mitch-the-Metastasis long before he shows up on a standard Roentgen-Ray.
cards.gradeReason: Glowing wherever bone-builders hustle — whole-body radar, vivid and performative.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro nuclear card. Subject: Flaming skeleton glowing hot-spots at metastasis sites, repair-builders visible, Roentgen-Ray standing blind. Mood: Anticipatory, early.

cards.power: The Cancer-Crate. A Cold-Node isn't making hormone. In ENT, this is highly suspicious.
cards.lore: Hot-Nodes are overactive but benign. Cold-Nodes are silent, sneaky, and potentially lethal.
cards.gradeReason: Silent darkness = lethal suspicion. Hot=benign, Cold=danger. Instantly memorable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro nuclear card. Subject: Purple moth thyroid cold node, void of uptake, silent sneaky cancer lurking in darkness. Mood: Silent, sinister.

cards.power: The Hunger-Detector. Shows which cells are Eating-Sugar the fastest. Tumor-Max is always hungry.
cards.lore: Cancer cells are Anabolic Gluttons (Warburg Effect), turning them into glaring Neon-Signs.
cards.gradeReason: Sugar glider PET scan eating tumors — Warburg Effect made delicious and immediate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro nuclear card. Subject: Glowing sugar-glider PET scan, tumor cells lit neon by FDG hunger, Warburg effect visualized. Mood: Hungry, glowing.

cards.power: The Clot-Hunter. Finds the area of lung that is Breathing fine but has No-Blood-Flow.
cards.lore: The classic scintigraphic signature of a massive Pulmonary Embolism.
cards.gradeReason: Ventilation without perfusion = PE. Clean logic, immediate diagnostic story.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro nuclear card. Subject: Split-lung scan, one half ventilated bright, other half dark perfusion void, clot-hunter tracking PE. Mood: Diagnostic, split.

cards.power: The Wire-Master. Seldinger lets the surgeon enter any Pipe in the body through a tiny pinhole.
cards.lore: The foundation of IR. Once the Guidewire-Ghost is placed, the Catheter-Cavalry can safely follow.
cards.gradeReason: Wire through pinhole is precise but the Needle→Wire→Catheter chain needs demonstration.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro technique card. Subject: Wire-master ghost guiding catheter cavalry through pinhole vessel entry, Seldinger sequence visible. Mood: Precise, foundational.

cards.power: The Bleed-Stopper. Intentionally blocks a Leaky-Pipe to stop a hemorrhage or starve a tumor.
cards.lore: Creates a perfectly timed Strategic-Clot exactly where the plumbing is failing most.
cards.gradeReason: Intentional clot as weapon — the strategic clot concept is thrillingly counterintuitive.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro intervention card. Subject: Beaver coiling embolization beads into leaky tumor vessel, strategic clot starving malignancy. Mood: Tactical, decisive.

cards.power: The Pipe-Prop. Pushes Athero-Al's gunk tightly against the wall to keep the Highway open.
cards.lore: Installs permanent, unyielding structural support for a failing, narrowed Vessel-Wall.
cards.gradeReason: Scaffold holding vessel open is clear but self-expanding vs. balloon detail needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro engineering card. Subject: Armadillo stent scaffold expanding in narrowed vessel, plaque compressed against wall, highway reopened. Mood: Structural, permanent.

cards.power: The Pus-Vacuum. Bypasses the Blade-Brigade to safely suck infection through a tiny tube.
cards.lore: Relies on Gravity-and-Negative-Pressure to entirely drain the deeply buried Septic-Swamp.
cards.gradeReason: Pus-vacuum sucking swamp through tiny tube — grotesque and instantly actionable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro intervention card. Subject: Pigtail mosquito catheter sucking septic abscess swamp dry, gravity and negative pressure draining deep infection. Mood: Satisfying, precise.

cards.power: The Blood-Seeker. Scans the belly and heart-sac in seconds to hunt for hidden hemorrhage.
cards.lore: A positive FAST-Fiona means the wrestler is actively bleeding internally — straight to the OR!
cards.gradeReason: Scanning for blood in seconds, straight to OR — trauma urgency is perfectly encoded.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro trauma card. Subject: Owl scanning trauma belly in seconds, blood found glowing in pericardium, OR arrow flashing. Mood: Urgent, decisive.

cards.power: The Heart-Crusher. A one-way air valve inflates until it squeezes the heart from pumping.
cards.lore: Primarily a clinical diagnosis, but Roentgen-Ray confirms it visually with a massive Vivid-Air-Space.
cards.gradeReason: One-way air valve crushing heart — devastating mechanic, everyone feels the squeeze.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro pneumo card. Subject: Puffer fish inflating to crush mediastinum, heart displaced, massive air space expanding. Mood: Fatal, relentless.

cards.power: The Hidden-Air-Detector. When a wrestler is lying flat, Tension-Tony's air hides at the bottom.
cards.lore: A subtle but increasingly important sign of a massive Pneumothorax in the supine ICU patient.
cards.gradeReason: Air hiding at the bottom when supine — clever but needs ICU clinical scenario context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro hidden-clue card. Subject: ICU patient supine, air pooling at deep costophrenic angle, Tension-Tony hiding below. Mood: Subtle, dangerous.

cards.power: The Double-Pipe. Shows the Wall-Tear that splits the main aorta into two competing tunnels.
cards.lore: High pressure violently rips the layers apart. If the tear hits the Heart-Gate, it's game over.
cards.gradeReason: Aorta splitting into two competing tunnels — catastrophic and vivid, zero setup needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro catastrophe card. Subject: Aorta ripped into true and false lumen pipes, intimal flap visible, heart-gate rupture imminent. Mood: Violent, fatal.

cards.power: The Risk-Meter. Tells the surgeon exactly how worried they need to be about a Lump-Max.
cards.lore: A score of 4 or 5 is a massive red flag meaning Biopsy-for-the-Win.
cards.gradeReason: Risk-meter 0–6 is clear but BIRADS scoring is specialist vocabulary that needs grounding.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro scoring card. Subject: Peacock risk meter scoring breast lump 0-6, surgeon anxiety rising at 4-5, biopsy flag raised. Mood: Calibrated, anxious.

cards.power: The Malignant-Signature. The distinct radiographic look of cancer Reaching-Out to invade.
cards.lore: Desmoplastic reaction physically shortens and pulls on the surrounding Cooper's-Ligaments.
cards.gradeReason: Cancer reaching out with radiating spines — malignance made visible and terrifying.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro malignant card. Subject: Spider star-shaped mass on mammogram, radiating spicules reaching to invade, Cooper's ligaments pulling. Mood: Invasive, signature.

cards.power: The DCIS-Signal. Tiny, jagged white dots that look like Cracked-Salt, often the only early sign.
cards.lore: Microscopic apoptotic debris inside the breast ducts that has died and turned to stone.
cards.gradeReason: Cracked-salt dots visible on mammogram — needs specialist eye to perform confidently.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro early-warning card. Subject: Cracked salt microcalcification dots in breast duct, DCIS visible before invasion, stone-turned debris. Mood: Early, subtle.

cards.power: The Solid-Finder. If the sound waves can't pierce through the lump, it's highly suspicious.
cards.lore: Malignant tissue is Dense-and-Absorbing, while benign simple cysts are Fluid-and-Transmitting.
cards.gradeReason: Sound blocked by solid mass versus fluid — clean logic but needs ultrasound context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro breast US card. Subject: Shark solid lump blocking ultrasound beam, posterior shadow, suspicious dense mass versus clear cyst. Mood: Suspicious, dense.

cards.power: The Radiation-Shield. Ensures we use the absolute minimum Roentgen-Rays needed to win.
cards.lore: Dictates Time, Distance, and Shielding. Use Echo or Mag whenever possible instead.
cards.gradeReason: ALARA as principle-character hybrid — more doctrine than persona, needs referee mode.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro safety card. Subject: Armadillo holding radiation shield, ALARA principle enforced, time-distance-shielding triangle glowing. Mood: Protective, principled.

cards.power: The Photon-Stop. Lead armor stops stray Roentgen-Rays from hitting the Ovarian-Bench.
cards.lore: The incredibly high atomic number of lead absorbs the incoming X-ray energy before it hits DNA.
cards.gradeReason: Lead stopping photons is clear but PPE card needs safety-rules framing to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro protection card. Subject: Elephant in lead apron stopping X-ray photon barrage, ovarian bench shielded behind atomic armor. Mood: Shielding, heavy.

cards.power: The Fetal-Defense. The supreme rule: always ask if there is a Fetal-Fighter in the fortress.
cards.lore: Ionizing radiation is infinitely more dangerous during the delicate Organ-Creation phase.
cards.gradeReason: Always ask about the Fetal-Fighter — supreme rule, zero ambiguity, instant behavioral change.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro contraindication card. Subject: Kangaroo mother holding HALT sign, fetus in pouch, radiation banned from fortress, first trimester. Mood: Absolute, protective.

cards.power: The Magnetic-Attraction. Mag-the-Magnet turns wheelchairs and pacemakers into Lethal-Projectiles.
cards.lore: The magnet is ALWAYS ON; it will rip ferromagnetic metal through the air like a fired rocket.
cards.gradeReason: Wheelchair fired like a missile — most viscerally unforgettable safety card in radiology.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro hazard card. Subject: Wheelchair and pacemaker fired as missiles toward MRI bore, magnet always-on, lethal projectile trajectory. Mood: Terrifying, instant.

cards.power: The Infinite-Memory. PACS stores every scan the wrestler has ever had for Old-vs-New battles.
cards.lore: Comparison is the key to Radiology. A terrifying lump from 2020 is much safer if it hasn't grown.
cards.gradeReason: Old-vs-new comparison logic is sharp but PACS as persona needs digital-library setup.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro archive card. Subject: Digital library sphinx holding stacks of DICOM scans, old vs new comparison glowing, lump stability measured. Mood: Temporal, methodical.

cards.power: The Cancer-Collar. Shows precisely where Malignant-Max has wrapped entirely around the colon.
cards.lore: The classic, definitive hallmark of advanced colon cancer visualized on a Barium-Enema.
cards.gradeReason: Cancer collar choking the colon apple-core — visual, definitive, immediately haunting.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro cancer card. Subject: Beaver colon cancer collar wrapping circumferential apple-core, barium enema revealing classic constriction. Mood: Definitive, grim.

cards.power: The End-Stage-Lung. Chronic inflammation turns the flexible breathing-balloons into useless cysts.
cards.lore: The irreversible signature of Pulmonary Fibrosis. The lungs are now permanent, unyielding stone.
cards.gradeReason: Breathing balloons turned to rigid stone honeycombs — accurate but end-stage needs framing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro fibrosis card. Subject: Bear lungs transformed to rigid honeycomb stone cysts, subpleural rows stacked, pulmonary fibrosis endgame. Mood: Irreversible, heavy.

cards.power: The Airway-Alarm. A massive warning that the wrestler's primary breathing tube is swelling shut.
cards.lore: The delicate epiglottis leaf swells up so large it looks exactly like a giant thumb on the X-ray.
cards.gradeReason: Epiglottis swelling to thumb-size on X-ray — grotesque image locked forever in memory.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro airway card. Subject: Giant thumb epiglottis swelling on lateral neck X-ray, airway alarm flashing, breathing tube closing. Mood: Grotesque, urgent.

cards.power: The Pattern-Recognizer. Doc: 'Don't just look, see! Is the silhouette lost? Is the HU correct? Compare it to the old films or stay in the dark! Stay fluffy!'
cards.lore: Don't just look, see! Is the silhouette lost? Is the HU correct? Compare it to the old films or stay in the dark! Stay Fluffy!
cards.gradeReason: Doc FrizzleBob as attending radiologist — meta-card that teaches method AND persona.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro mentor card. Subject: FrizzleBob rabbit in dark reading room, pattern-recognizer attending, old films and new scans compared. Mood: Wise, sharp.

cards.lore: Trauma wrestler. Sharp pain, low SpO2. Supine chest X-ray shows Deep-Sulcus-Sign.
cards.gradeReason: Quiz scenario not a playable card — describes a clinical case rather than inviting performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro quest card. Subject: FrizzleBob and mole examining supine X-ray for hidden air, synthesis challenge framed. Mood: Educational, investigative.

cards.lore: A CT head scan shows Crescent-Chris on the left side and Lemon-Lenny on the right.
cards.gradeReason: Differentiate-the-bleeds quiz — teaching tool masquerading as a card, G3 by design.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro quiz card. Subject: FrizzleBob holding banana and lemon brain shapes, two bleeds to identify, CT scan background. Mood: Cerebral, comparative.

cards.lore: A PET scan shows the Malignant-Max and Metastasis-Mitch, and explain exactly why their cells glow so bright on the scan.
cards.gradeReason: Warburg Effect explanation quest — valuable teaching but firmly a written exercise.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro quest card. Subject: FrizzleBob chasing glowing cancer cells on PET scan, golden glow quest background. Mood: Investigative, cellular.

verdict: MedKayfab Radiology is a tour de force of educational card design — 52 vivid personas covering X-ray physics, CT, MRI, ultrasound, nuclear medicine, interventional radiology, breast imaging, and radiation safety in a single deck. The Warburg-Effect sugar-eater, the magnet-fired wheelchair, the lemon versus crescent brain bleeds: these stick. The three Synthesis Quest cards (54–56) are the one structural wrinkle — they are written exercises disguised as play cards. Table-ready: YES for medical education contexts.
blurb: Radiology's entire visual library transformed into 56 performable characters — from Roentgen-Ray to the magnet-fired wheelchair missile. For med students who learn by doing, not memorizing.
